title: docs(org): move all v1 pages to /v1/
body:
Fixes #2236

I will publish this one right now because it's non destructive (there's no /v1/ today).

comments.body:
I don't really know WHY but clearly with our current setup yarn would not manage to finish on is v1. So I moved to npm5 package-lock.json and it works.

![giphy](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/123822/31099419-363c4df2-a7c6-11e7-9ed5-4bf779ddf04c.gif)
Tested the publish script and it works, it publishes to v1 with the right assets paths. I added that to CONTRIBUTING.md in case we want to publish v1 docs again, that's doable.
I added the right cloudflare rules as for v1 redirection
